basics.name: Patience Edem Hogan
basics.label: Early Years Education Leader | Curriculum Developer | Montessori Specialist
basics.summary: Innovative educational leader and passionate advocate for early years development with over two decades of experience across West Africa. Proven track record founding educational institutions, designing early years resources, and training educators in Montessori pedagogy. Combines a creative background in Theatre Arts with robust educational management to drive holistic child development and early literacy — currently advancing academic credentials while scaling cognitive development initiatives for youth.
